title: Practical Walkthrough: Converting Standup Notes into Clean Tickets
text: Questions. One, is it mechanical? Reshaping information that already exists, summarizing, drafting, sorting, or is it a call like choosing what matters? Two, is it reversible? Can you check it in seconds and undo it, or do teammates act on it the moment it's posted? Three, is the truth actually in the tool, or does it live in someone's head, a client call, a Slack thread the AI can't see?
